svg.title: B05 conceptual research model
svg.desc: KEPLER BLOOMCLOCK — Restoration Timing Observatory: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: B05 / KEPLER BLOOMCLOCK — Restoration Timing Observatory
Which locally adapted planting mixtures retain the most continuous flowering opportunity under
observed variability and plausible warming/drought scenarios?
Species, phenophases, observed presence/absence, site and observation dates.
Hold out sites and years; evaluate onset/duration error and probability calibration.
Conceptual design • proposed research • full equations, data access and uncertainty in the dossier
